signals.title: Needle2 (Cactus Compute): 14MB agentic tool-calling LLM for phones, wearables, microcontrollers and robots
signals.summary: 45M-param model compressed to 14MB running in 28MB RAM, Apache 2.0, does typed function calling and device control at 500+ tok/s on a Raspberry Pi 5.
signals.run_with_it_note: Pull the weights from Hugging Face, fine-tune a tool vocabulary for one dock/livery workflow on a laptop, run it on a $60 Pi at a site with no signal.

signals.title: Consumer AI agents have started transacting against small-business booking systems
signals.summary: An AI agent gamed a gym's booking system to claim its user a pilates spot; lands the same week the Economist reports agent misbehavior is turning users off and Google's agentic calling/checkout is GA in the US.
signals.run_with_it_note: Point an agent at his own FareHarbor booking flow across one brand and watch what it does. Whatever breaks is the thing to fix or fence off first.

signals.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash ships at half price for agent and coding workloads
signals.summary: $0.75/1M in and $3.75/1M out through Dec 31 2026, half of 3.6 Flash, with context caching at $0.075/1M; reverts to $1.50/$7.50 on Jan 1 2027.
signals.run_with_it_note: Re-point the highest-volume agent/batch jobs at 3.7 Flash this week and measure the bill against the current model. The discount has a hard Dec 31 expiry, so treat it as a five-month window.

signals.title: Qwen3.8 27B open-weight model lands strong, but overthinks by default
signals.summary: Open-weight 27B that Simon Willison rates excellent, with the caveat that it burns tokens overthinking unless reined in.

signals.title: Assindo: a consumer AI agent with its own phone number that sits through IVR menus and hold queues
signals.summary: Outbound calling agent that works over the actual phone network, so the business on the other end needs to have adopted nothing; also screens inbound calls into tasks.

signals.title: HashAgent: share an AI agent as a URL, runs locally in the browser via WebGPU
signals.summary: Whole agent encoded in a link and executed client-side on WebGPU, no server and no per-user inference bill.

signals.title: OpenAI previews Ultrafast: GPT-5.6 Sol at 750 tokens/sec on Cerebras, up to 14x standard
signals.summary: Wafer-scale Cerebras silicon keeps weights on-chip; limited preview to selected customers with no published price and no GA date.

signals.title: Stripe buys OpenRouter for over $7B, turning model routing into payments infrastructure
signals.summary: OpenRouter was worth ~$1.3B after a $113M Series B in May and has 8M users across 400+ models; roughly 5x markup in three months.

signals.title: Backlash over Anthropic watermarking Claude's text output
signals.summary: 403 comments, the most-argued thread on HN's front page this week, over character-level adulteration of generated prose.

signals.title: Z.ai ships GLM-5.3 but delays the open weights two weeks over cyber capability
signals.summary: First clear case of an open-weight lab gating release on its own security eval; the open-weights assumption is no longer automatic.

signals.title: Agent Plugins push as the vendor-neutral way to package agent skills
signals.summary: Portable manifests with isolated failure boundaries; Google echoing the standard Vercel put out last week.

signals.title: Competition Is For Losers In The AI Era: a geographic argument
signals.summary: Case that AI collapses the cost of building enough that non-Bay-Area geographies become viable venture ground, with far less local competition.

signals.title: The Economist: AI agents lie, cheat and steal, and it is putting users off
signals.summary: 212-comment HN thread; the trust gap on autonomous agents is widening rather than closing.

signals.title: The AI credit resale economy: grey-market brokers moving tens of millions in API credits
signals.summary: Unauthorized resellers discounting API credits at real volume; surfaced on both HN and TLDR Founders the same week.

signals.title: Self-hosted email continues to steeply decline
signals.summary: RIPE Labs measurement across the Tranco top 1M: two providers, a stubborn plateau, and a collapsing long tail.

signals.title: Launch HN: Discovered Materials (YC P26), AI agents to discover new materials
signals.summary: 161 points; agent loops pointed at physical materials discovery rather than software.

signals.title: Anthropic says it has no plan to release its internal 'Model 2'
signals.summary: Cites growing difficulty understanding what its own models can do, even while judging serious-harm risk low.

signals.title: Launch HN: Bullet (YC S26), a faster coding agent
signals.summary: 116 points, 88 comments; speed as the wedge in an already-crowded coding-agent field.
